The replays have clearly shown TCU grabbing and pulling Ngongba and Brown off balance and managed to draw 2 fouls. Edmunds lunges into Ngongba’s knee, which was a foul, then as they go down together, he wraps his legs around Ngongba’s in an attempt to injure him. Blatant flagrant.
